subject: general
question: On 31 May 2025, which of the following banks of India waived the minimum balance requirement on all savings accounts?
solution: The correct answer is __**Canara Bank**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Canara Bank** waived the **minimum balance requirement** on all savings accounts effective from **31 May 2025**. • This initiative was taken to promote **financial inclusion**, ensuring banking services are accessible to all, particularly individuals in rural and semi-urban areas. • The removal of the minimum balance requirement helps customers avoid **non-maintenance penalties**, easing financial burdens on low-income groups. • Canara Bank has consistently been at the forefront of implementing customer-friendly policies, and this decision aligns with its vision to offer **affordable and inclusive banking solutions**. • Other key benefits of this step include increased customer satisfaction, fostering trust, and enabling **unrestricted access to banking** for its savings account holders.
